title: Page 10
content_zh:
她匆忙的离开，失去她跟孩子，主卧室里变得冷清清。
心像被硬生生撕裂一半，空荡荡的难受起来。
自从叶咏欢母子住进家里，苏劲沧都尽量减少应酬早回家，单身为集团的总裁，还是有些不得不去的场合。
这晚他招待以为相识多年的好友兼生意夥伴，远从欧洲来的好友喜欢台北酒吧的气氛，非要他一起去不可。
「苏，你看，这是我的妻子和儿子。」
高大的金发男子拿出珍藏在皮夹里的照片，脸上是掩饰不住的欣喜和幸福，一副居家好男人的模样，很难想象她两年前还是个流连花丛的花花公子。
照片中的女子怀抱着刚出生的婴儿，亲密的黏在丈夫的身旁，一家人笑得甜蜜美满。
「我儿子像不像我？你看看他的眼睛、鼻子。」
苏劲沧瞥了一眼，接着不服气的哼了声。
「我儿子才像我呢！」
「儿子？你什么时候有了儿子？我怎么不知道？」
苏劲沧喝了口威士忌，才把事情娓娓道来。
「那很好啊！你们一家人又重聚了。咦？不过也不一定啦，如果你不喜欢你前妻的话，为了孩子勉强在一起也不会幸福。」
「谁说我不喜欢她？！」苏劲沧听到好友这么说，下意识就大声反驳。
金发男子嘿嘿的笑了起来。「那不就好了。HappyEnding。啊啊——我记得你跟我提过你的前妻，就是那个从小就黏着你，爱你爱得要命的女孩嘛！呵呵，你可真幸福啊！像我，可是花了好多心血才追到我老婆的。你倒好，不费吹灰之力。」
第9章(2)
苏劲沧犹如哑巴吃黄连，他没有办法跟好友说，现在她其实对他避之唯恐不及，像老鼠见了猫一样，他连好好跟她说话的机会都没有，更别说想要抱抱她、亲亲她了。
这就是所谓的报应吗？当他被爱时，他没有珍惜，还觉得烦，现在她的刻意疏离让他烦躁焦急得不知如何是好。
想到她可能不再爱他了，可能永远不会再用那种依恋的眼睛看他时，他被一种深沉的恐惧所占据了。
听着好友滔滔不绝的炫耀着他的幸福婚姻生活，他不是滋味的猛灌酒，可再多的酒精似乎都麻痹不了心痛的感觉，于是他又喝更多了……

到了要回家时，他已经有些步履蹒跚了。
一向自制力很强的他很少这么失控，好友也不禁担忧。
「嘿，苏，你还好吧？怎么了？」
「没事。」他挥挥手，拒绝了好友的关心。他没有办法把关于她的事情跟任何人分享，他从来不是个知道怎么倾吐心事的男人。
想到回家，苏劲沧的心情是期待又苦闷的。
夜深了，叶咏欢还在客厅里。儿子早就睡了，她却有些放心不下，坐在客厅里等他。
这种行为根本就没有必要，她知道，只要看到他平安回来，她就立刻上去睡觉——这样的为自己的行为找理由，想想她也真是傻得很。
过了午夜十二点，大门才传出动静。
苏劲沧出现在门口，一身酒气。
从没有看他喝醉过，叶咏欢有些意外。他过于火热又带点疯狂的视线透出一种危险的讯号，让她不由得退了一步。
她又在躲他了。
本来看到她时苏劲沧很想紧紧拥抱她，可她眼中的退缩像针一样的扎进他的胸口，那疼痛因为酒精的关系而放大号几倍。
「不……不要走……你回、回来……」
眼前的地板好像在起伏晃动，他困难的走近她，像是溺水的人抓住浮木般紧紧的抓着她。
「抓、抓到你了……你不要再走……不要再离开我……」
喝醉的男人有种无法开解的执拗，叶咏欢被吓傻了。她心目中的苏大哥永远是冷静、严肃、认真的？她没看过他这个样子，他喝醉了就好像……好像小佟在耍赖的时候……
「放手。」
她挣扎，他却抱得更紧。
「好痛……」
「对不起……可是我不放手，不会再放手了……」

怎么会这样？叶咏欢不知所措的看着他。
「我扶你上去睡觉好不好？你喝醉了。」
红着眼睛、不讲道理的他让她觉得可怜又有点可爱。唉，她只能说自己真的爱惨他了，连他这样失态的模样在她 眼里也变成颓废的帅气。
他没有意见，只要她在他身边。
叶咏欢扶他上楼去，将他安置在床上，然后准备去浴室拧条毛巾来替他擦脸。「不要！别走！」
「我只是去……」
「不管，别走。」
说来说去就是不准她离开，叶咏欢又好气又无奈。「你到底要干麽？」
他用力一扯，将她紧紧拥在怀中。
终于可以好好抱她了！苏劲沧神智迷乱的抱着她又亲又摸，理智早就抛在脑后，现在他只想要放纵自己好好的亲近她。
真的好想要这个人！好想把她揉进体内！这样她就再也不会逃走了……
「不、不要……」叶咏欢又羞又窘，被他这么霸道的抚摸和拥抱，全身又热又软，几乎就要无法呼吸。
可她越是挣扎，他就越恐惧。
「别离开我，我爱你，我好爱、好爱你……我不知道以前为什么没有发现，可是失去之后，我才知道……我不能没有你。我想要你，你再像以前那样喜欢我好不好？我不会再让你难过了，我保证。求求你……求求你……至少不要不理我，你不理我的时候，我的心好难过、好难过……」
眼前胡乱说着话的男人眼眶红红的，抱着她的手颤抖着。
他在发抖……平常那么强势又高傲的苏大哥竟然发着抖……
她太惊愕了，惊讶之后旋即被强烈的情感所淹没。
老天爷、上帝、阿拉、还有其他所有的众神啊！谁来告诉她这不是一场美梦而已？
苏劲沧在头痛欲裂的情况下醒来，张开眼，对上的是一双闪闪发亮的眼睛。
她趴在床前看着他，那样子让他感觉像是一只在等待主人醒过来跟它玩的小狗。

他困难的吞了口口水，太阳穴隐隐作痛。
昨天他喝醉了，可他不是什么都不记得，他记得自己说了一些话……一些很不得了的话……
现在面对她闪亮得刺眼的眼睛，他背上冒出冷汗，很想否认昨天那个丢脸的男人是自己。
可苏劲沧看到她红通通的脸颊，还有那止不住的羞涩笑容时，他就知道昨天晚上的事不是梦。
「再跟我说一次好吗？」
「说什么？」他僵硬的反问。
「说你喜欢我啊！像你昨天说的那样。」
哪有可能说得出口啊！
深深的为她的没神经而伤脑筋，他只觉得宿醉的症状更严重了，头痛得不得了。
叶咏欢难过的垂下头，眼里的光彩在一瞬间消失了，只剩下令人心疼的空洞。
「果然！那只是喝醉之后的醉话吗？我就知道不可能是真的……算了。」她站起来，像失去力气般沮丧的转身。
苏劲沧的心纠结起来，当她说「算了」，当她要走……他急忙的拉住她。
「不！别走。」
她忧伤的回头，苦笑。「拜托你，不要再乱开玩笑了，就算是醉话也不要乱说好吗？我已经决定放弃你了，不要再给我希望。」
什么决定放弃？！她怎么可以放弃？又怎么能够片面决定这种事！
「不、不要说这种话，我……是真的，我喜欢你。」他豁出去了。
从来只有一号冷漠表情的男人竟然脸红了。
光彩重新回到叶咏欢灰暗的脸庞，她眨眨眼，再眨眼，简直不敢相信……
content_en:
She left in a hurry, without her and her child, the master bedroom became deserted.
My heart felt like it had been torn in half, feeling empty and uncomfortable.
Ever since Ye Yonghuan and his son moved into the house, Su Jincang had tried to minimize socializing and go home early. As a single CEO of a group, there were still some occasions where he had to go.
That night he entertained a friend and business partner who he thought he had known for many years. His friend from Europe liked the atmosphere of the Taipei bar and insisted that he go with him.
"Sue, look, these are my wife and son."
The tall blond man took out the photos he had collected in his wallet. His face was full of joy and happiness, and he looked like a good family man. It was hard to imagine that she was just a playboy who wandered around the world two years ago.
The woman in the photo is holding her newborn baby in her arms, clinging closely to her husband's side, and the family is smiling sweetly.
"Does my son look like me? Look at his eyes and nose."
Su Jincang glanced at it, then snorted unconvinced.
"My son is just like me!"
"Son? When did you have a son? Why didn't I know?"
Su Jincang took a sip of whiskey before explaining the matter.
"That's great! Your family is reunited again. Huh? But that's not necessarily the case. If you don't like your ex-wife, you won't be happy if you force yourself to be together for the sake of your children."
"Who said I don't like her?!" Su Jincang heard his friend say this and subconsciously retorted loudly.
The blond man chuckled. "That's great. Happy Ending. Ahhh - I remember you told me about your ex-wife, the girl who has been clinging to you since childhood and loved you to death! Haha, you are so happy! Like me, it took a lot of effort to catch up with my wife. It's good for you, it's effortless."
Chapter 9(2)
Su Jincang is like a mute eating coptis. He has no way to tell his friend that now she is actually avoiding him. Like a mouse seeing a cat, he doesn't even have a chance to talk to her properly, let alone want to hug her or kiss her.
Is this what is called retribution? When he was loved, he didn't cherish it and felt annoyed. Now her deliberate alienation made him so irritated and anxious that he didn't know what to do.
He was seized with a deep fear at the thought that she might no longer love him, might never look at him with those loving eyes again.
Listening to his good friend gushing about his happy married life, he drank heavily, but no amount of alcohol seemed to numb the feeling of heartache, so he drank more...
By the time it was time to go home, he was already reeling.
He has always had strong self-control and rarely loses control like this, and his friends can't help but worry.
"Hey Sue, are you okay? What's wrong?"
"It's okay." He waved his hand, rejecting his friend's concern. He couldn't share anything about her with anyone. He had never been a man who knew how to talk about his feelings.
Thinking of going home, Su Jincang felt expectant and depressed.
It was late at night, and Ye Yonghuan was still in the living room. Her son had gone to bed long ago, but she was a little worried and sat in the living room waiting for him.
This kind of behavior is completely unnecessary. She knows that as long as she sees him coming back safely, she will go to bed immediately - she is really stupid to find reasons for her behavior like this.
It was after midnight that there was movement at the door.
Su Jincang appeared at the door, smelling of alcohol.
Ye Yonghuan was a little surprised as he had never seen him drunk before. His overly hot and slightly crazy gaze gave off a dangerous signal, causing her to take a step back.
She was avoiding him again.
Su Jincang originally wanted to hug her tightly when he saw her, but the flinch in her eyes pierced his chest like a needle, and the pain was magnified several times because of the alcohol.
"No...don't leave...come back...come back..."
The floor in front of me looks likeWhile undulating, he approached her with difficulty, holding her tightly like a drowning man holding on to driftwood.
"I've caught you...don't leave again...don't leave me again..."
The drunk man had an inexplicable stubbornness, and Ye Yonghuan was frightened. In her mind, Brother Su is always calm, serious and serious? She had never seen him like this before. When he was drunk, he looked like...like when Xiao Tong was cheating...
"Let go."
She struggled, but he held her tighter.
"It hurts..."
"I'm sorry...but I won't let go, and I won't let go again..."
How could this happen? Ye Yonghuan looked at him at a loss.
"Can I help you up to sleep? You're drunk."
The red-eyed, unreasonable man made her feel pitiful and a little cute. Alas, she could only say that she really loved him, and even his rude appearance turned into decadent handsomeness in her eyes.
He had no problem with it, as long as she was by his side.
Ye Yonghuan helped him go upstairs, placed him on the bed, and then went to the bathroom to twist a towel to wipe his face. "No! Don't leave!"
"I'm just going to..."
"Whatever, don't leave."
After all, she was not allowed to leave. Ye Yonghuan was angry and helpless. "What on earth do you want to do?"
He pulled hard and held her tightly in his arms.
I can finally hold her properly! Su Jincang was in a state of confusion as he held her, kissed and touched her. Reason had long been forgotten, and now he just wanted to indulge himself and get close to her.
I really want this person! I really want to rub her inside me! This way she will never run away again...
"No, don't..." Ye Yonghuan was ashamed and embarrassed. Being touched and hugged by him so domineeringly, her whole body felt hot and soft, and she almost couldn't breathe.
But the more she struggled, the more frightened he became.
"Don't leave me, I love you, I love you so much... I don't know why I didn't realize it before, but after I lost it, I realized... I can't live without you. I want you, can you like me like you did before? I won't make you sad anymore, I promise. Please... please... at least don't ignore me. When you ignore me, I feel so sad, so sad..."
The man talking nonsense in front of her had red eyes, and the hand holding her was trembling.
He is trembling... Brother Su, who is usually so strong and arrogant, is actually trembling...
She was so surprised that she was immediately overwhelmed by strong emotions.
O God, God, Allah, and all the other gods! Who will tell her that this is not just a sweet dream?
Su Jincang woke up with a splitting headache. When he opened his eyes, he was met with a pair of shining eyes.
She lay lying in front of the bed and looked at him. The way she looked made him feel like a puppy waiting for its owner to wake up and play with it.
He swallowed hard, his temples aching.
He was drunk yesterday, but it's not that he didn't remember anything. He remembered that he said some things... some very remarkable things...
Now facing her dazzling eyes, cold sweat broke out on his back, and he wanted to deny that the embarrassing man yesterday was him.
But when Su Jincang saw her red cheeks and her uncontrollable shy smile, he knew that what happened last night was not a dream.
"Can you tell me one more time?"
"What did you say?" he asked stiffly.
"Say you like me! Just like you said yesterday."
How could it possibly be said!
Deeply troubled by her lack of nerves, he only felt that the hangover symptoms were getting worse and he had a terrible headache.
Ye Yonghuan lowered his head sadly, the brightness in his eyes disappeared in an instant, leaving only a heart-wrenching void.
"Sure enough! Is that just a drunken remark? I knew it couldn't be true...forget it." She stood up and turned around in frustration as if she had lost her strength.
Su Jincang's heart became entangled, when she said "Forget it", when sheTo leave... He hurriedly grabbed her.
"No! Don't leave."
She looked back sadly and smiled bitterly. "Please, stop joking, even if you are drunk, please don't talk nonsense, okay? I have decided to give up on you, don't give me hope anymore."
What made you decide to give up? ! How could she give up? How can one decide such a thing one-sidedly!
"No, don't say such things, I...it's true, I like you." He risked his life.
The man who always had a cold expression turned red.
The light returned to Ye Yonghuan's gray face. She blinked and blinked again. She couldn't believe it...
